summary: Architecture review completed. Strategy Lab safety boundaries are strong and SHADOW-only by design, but durable net-P&L research quality is constrained by stale runtime evidence and a known Solana executable-edge feature gap.

proposals.strategy: Solana Executable Edge Adapter for Strategy Lab

evidence.detail: load_solana_market_features currently sets gross_edge_bps/fees/slippage/liquidity/sellability to fail-closed zeros and marks needs_quote_feature_adapter=true, so Solana strategies cannot be evaluated on contemporaneous executable edge after costs.

Scorecard aggregates forecast-related and quote-adapter evidence gaps and explicitly treats quote/simulation output as non-promotion evidence, indicating the architecture expects chain-specific executable evidence before promotion.
All strategy evaluators require positive net_edge_bps plus liquidity/sellability/quote-age gates; absent Solana quote features suppress eligible opportunities regardless of signal family.

proposals.rationale: Improving Solana feature adaptation to include current executable quote, liquidity, sellability and chain-specific cost fields would allow falsifiable SHADOW evaluation of the same economic hypotheses on SOLANA without weakening safety controls.
proposals.expected_effect: Higher-quality SOLANA shadow participation metrics and better comparability of money-weighted net P&L after costs versus EVM, while maintaining strict SHADOW and no-live-promotion safeguards.
proposals.downside_risk: If adapter quality is poor or stale, false eligibility could increase simulated optimism; mitigated by existing quote-age, sellability, liquidity, and simulation gates plus SHADOW-only policy.
proposals.shadow_test: For at least 3 windows and at least 8 eligible Solana opportunities, compare baseline vs improved adapter on: eligible participation ratio, quote-simulated net distribution, profit factor, and largest loss. Accept only if net and profit factor improve without a worse largest-loss profile.
research_plan: Add chain-specific Solana executable quote/cost feature extraction into the existing common adapter path.
Validate that missing inputs remain fail-closed and that no live execution path is touched.
Run chain-separated scorecard comparisons with identical strategy gate settings.

forecast.model_family: calibrated probabilistic classifier with abstain threshold
forecast.trade_threshold: abstain unless probability and expected net edge both pass strategy-specific minima
forecast.validation: time-ordered split with separate SOLANA results

evidence.detail: forecasted_positive_net_edge requires probability, expected edge and uncertainty thresholds with abstain logic, which is aligned to net-edge forecasting rather than direction-only prediction.
FORECAST_RESEARCH_SPEC already defines positive-net-edge target, no-lookahead constraints, calibration metrics, and chain-specific breakdown requirements.
Current Solana forecast fields derive from simple historical wallet stats and uncertainty proxy, not a calibrated pre-trade executable-edge model.

proposals.rationale: A chain-separated calibrated forecast can improve opportunity selection only if it demonstrates out-of-sample net edge after costs and robust loss control. Existing architecture has the right governance, but evidence quality is currently uneven across chains.
proposals.expected_effect: More reliable abstain behavior in low-confidence regimes and improved money-weighted net P&L quality in SHADOW by filtering weak-edge candidates.
proposals.downside_risk: Overfitting or leakage could produce misleading confidence; mitigated through strict time-ordered validation and chain-specific calibration checks before any promotion discussion.
proposals.shadow_test: Run a chain-separated out-of-sample shadow study with calibration (Brier/log-loss), net P&L after costs, profit factor, and largest loss. Keep only if both SOLANA and EVM show non-degraded downside and improved net-quality metrics versus current thresholds.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 2 market regimes and 8+ eligible opportunities per chain
research_plan: Keep forecast outputs declarative and SHADOW-only in the existing execution path.
Measure calibration and net-P&L quality metrics separately for SOLANA and EVM.
Retain abstain gate where uncertainty is high or expected edge is too low.

forecast.trade_threshold: abstain when uncertainty high or expected edge below threshold
forecast.validation: strict time-order split, chain-specific and regime-specific reporting

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy to canary/live from stale runtime evidence
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime evidence within 2h is false; this does not block architecture review completion but it blocks confidence in live/canary readiness claims.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade count by relaxing liquidity/sellability/quote-age thresholds
rejected_ideas.reason: Violates durable net-P&L objective and safety boundary; activity should follow positive edge plus executability, not forced participation.

evidence_gaps: Runtime evidence freshness is false for this cycle; profitability/live-readiness cannot be claimed from stale evidence.
Solana executable quote/liquidity/sellability feature coverage is currently incomplete in the common adapter path.
Cross-chain forecast calibration evidence is not yet demonstrated as robust out-of-sample on both chain types.
